description:
Put pages on the site and take them down, at any time. Every page goes live.
action:
- publish(articleId, connectionId?): Publish a written page to the connected site. Returns its URL.
- republish(articleId, baseHash, connectionId?): Send a live page's changes to the site, in place. Refused when the page changed since baseHash was read.
- take_down(articleId, into?, intoUrl?): Retire a page for good: off every connected site (a draft there, never deleted), never written, scheduled or linked again, its subject remembered. into: the live page its address should lead to. intoUrl instead: any live address on the site, for a landing page that isn't one of the pages here.
- undo_edit(revisionId): Put a live page back as it was before an agent edit (get_pages revisions), while nobody changed it since. Then republish.
name: publish_page
title: Publish pages
